name: Ichiban Boshi - Changi City Point
description:
MUST TRY: Items to look forward to includes their value meals which offer Wafu Beef Teppanyaki Wazen, Tontoro Teppanyaki Wazen and Scotch Eggs & Ishiyaki Seafood Wazen. Ichiban Sushi offers some of the best Japanese cuisines in Singapore, serving a tantalising collection of dishes that are suitable for casual dining and family gatherings. It presents a wide range of sushi and sashimi to combination set meals, specially prepared by their well-honed chef. Located at Changi City Point, Ichiban Sushi provides a vibrant and graceful atmosphere to make one's dining experience relaxed and truly memorable.Without sacrificing quality, Ichiban Sushi makes one of the most enjoyable and tasty dishes at affordable prices using only the freshest ingredients. Aside from sushi, they also offer a variety of homemade pastries and desserts. 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
